An entry that no longer suppresses anything is reported as a FINDING, so a
repaired or migrated site forces its entry out rather than leaving a standing
exemption for the name. Do not add an entry to quiet a gate you have not read.

adjudications.reason: This explicit projection IS the wire contract, and it was added deliberately in response to the failure this gate exists to catch: app/core/percentiles/reducer.js spreads the row straight into redux and percentile-metric.js plus stacked-metric.js read .p25/.p75/.min/.max, so a prior rename that let the physical names through collapsed the color arithmetic to NaN || 0. Migrating it is an SPA-visible rename, not a server change. The new-name key reads the gate lists (libs-shared/simulation/simulation-utils.mjs, scripts/generate-nfl-team-seasonlogs.mjs) are a different population -- they build percentile objects from their own computation and never read a row from this route.

UNIFORM in substance FOR THE points-map SHAPE: both producers of that row -- this file and scripts/process-projections-for-league-format.mjs -- alias back, and get_player_week_total (libs-shared/get-player-week-points.mjs:16-21) reads .total off each week's row. This is the column whose UNALIASED select wiped a year of projection values in 72346e579, so the alias is the repair rather than the residue. The new-name key reads the gate lists (scripts/process-projections-for-scoring-format.mjs:82,99) are the WRITER's insert payload, a different boundary that never reads a row from this select. Removing the alias means moving get_player_week_total and every consumer of the points map in the same change. SCOPE CAUTION, added 2026-08-06 by adversarial review: this reason is NOT a claim that only two sites query this table. libs-server/simulation/load-data-with-fallback.mjs:172 aliases the same column to a THIRD name (`as projection`) and reads it bare at :294, and libs-server/simulation/load-projection-data.mjs:121-133 selects and reads the physical name directly. Those feed different downstream shapes, not player.points[week].total, and none is gate-visible (an alias to `projection` targets no lost column). A future rename of this column must sweep libs-server/simulation/ and cannot rely on this entry as an inventory.

The second producer of the same shape, and its own comment records why: get_player_week_total reads .total, so an unaliased select hands every player NaN which becomes the -999 sentinel, and the writer below deletes by (league_format_id, year) before inserting. Both producers OF THE points-map SHAPE agree, which is the UNIFORM class this gate reports as a standing hazard rather than a defect. See the SCOPE CAUTION on the libs-server/get-players.mjs entry for this same column: two further query sites in libs-server/simulation/ use other vocabularies and are not covered by either entry.
